formIdentityNote: Both documents are the North Carolina Administrative Office of the Courts' own published forms, bound by exact SHA-256 through the committed corpus index and delivered as the AOC issues them. G.S. 15A-146(c) requires a petition under this section to be on a form approved by the AOC, so substituting or composing one would make the filing refusable on its face; nothing here is composed, substituted or invented. AOC-CR-288 replaced AOC-CR-264 for G.S. 15A-146(a2) petitions and says so on its own face.
